name: Jaunting
body:
Associated Discipline: Psychoportation

Replacement Ability: The following discipline abilities replace the accelerated activity and rapid movement abilities of the psychoportation discipline.

Evacuate (Su): At 14th level, once per day, you can teleport anywhere within line of sight as an immediate action. You can bring along up to your Intelligence modifier in creatures touching you.

Far Strider (Su): At 20th level, you can use your nomad’s step ability as a free action. You cannot use this ability if you have already taken a 5 ft. step this round, and using this ability counts as using your 5 ft. step.
